description: Use when you need to translate text, a language translation or a text translation of a sentence or paragraph between two languages. Do not use for formatting that must be preserved, certified or legal translation, or speech (transcribe first). Returns JSON with text translation between about 100 languages by Meta M2M100 1.2B on Workers AI: the translated text with the source and target languages used for 0.012 USDC per call. Typical response time 5000 ms (p95). Category: Inference.

from.description: Source language as an ISO 639-1 code (default en)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

text.description: Text to translate, e.g. Pay only for the requests you make (up to 2000 characters)

to.description: Target language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. es, fr, pt, de, ja, zh

name: blackwood_text_translate

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Translate text
